canonical_data: per-agent conversation sessions saved as structured files under the runtime directory, plus files the agents write inside the configured workspace
current_repo_note: Covers two of the role's four surfaces: files and the web, but not applications or scheduled work; its tool-server agent is disabled as non-functional and no scheduler exists. It passes the operational test that excluded paper projects, with the loop in a library behind a real test suite, but no continuous integration runs those tests and no release has ever been cut.
strengths: The browser agent is a genuine navigation loop with form filling, stuck detection, and an explicit exit action
Workspace confinement and loopback-only publishing were added deliberately, with tests behind the safe-mode fix
Local models are the primary path and every hosted key is optional
weaknesses: No continuous integration and no release has ever been cut, so the test suite is only as good as the maintainer's machine
Command execution runs unconfirmed by default, safe mode is a word blocklist, and the browser prompt tells the model never to ask the user
Two of the role's four surfaces are absent, and the tool-server agent is disabled as non-functional
why_it_matters: The most-adopted attempt at a fully local general work agent, showing how far router-plus-planner delegation reaches on consumer hardware before connectors and scheduling exist.
